title: repository-architecture-alignment
risks: Audit/integration completion does not close V01-008, the 12 residual M0 gates, 15 Alpha capabilities or six release targets; production authentication/business Host, writes, clients, Explorer and Provider remain scoped by existing evidence.

Path attribute checks retain a check-to-use race and cannot forcibly cancel a stalled synchronous NAS/kernel call. No real 500,000-asset NAS, 1-100 GiB, capacity, hard isolation or long-running soak proof is claimed.

Database-aware Host readiness now requires migration 13; existing databases must use the verified-backup forward migration workflow. The Windows pg_dump used here needs a sufficiently short backup path.

Nine file-free ALIGN-002 sandbox directories remain after two automatic approval rejections (blocked by policy). No bypass was attempted; ignored cache/runtime residue is distinguished from Git cleanliness.
NAS Linux worktree administrative pointers remain in their native form; Windows prunable labels do not mean those existing directories are abandoned.

architecture_review.module: Repository integration coordinator; AssetIdentity migration 13 sole owner; reviewed LibraryStorage/ScanReconciliation, Web and M0 packaging/Shell owner branches
reused_existing_logic: Existing root-probe/discovery ports, scan abort/state journaling and bounded observation batches.
Generated AssetLink SDK, shared browser request path, query generation guards and React remount lifecycle.
Existing AssetIdentity read projection and generated path document, GIN/keyset query, GatewayAuth permission filtering and backup-first migration tool.
Existing M0 host, lifetime, build-info provenance, central package pin and bounded platform test helpers.
duplicated_logic: Small ancestor checks remain adapter-local in each owning Infrastructure module to avoid a cross-module internal dependency; no permission, identity, transfer or trash business policy is duplicated.
cross_module_access: No new cross-module table writes or Infrastructure references. GatewayAuth retains its approved read-only projection/function access; UI remains an adapter.
contract_changes: Append-only AssetIdentity migration 13 replaces only the existing read-search function body. Migrations 1-12, function signature/OID/owner/ACL, role model, public wire schemas and generated SDK are unchanged. Host embedded-ledger tests advance to 13.
architecture_tests: 531 unique tests across the exact suites recorded in tests.md, with zero final failures/skips; Kotlin native self-test and CLI gates counted separately.
Locked .NET restore, formatting, zero-warning Release compilation; 11-project/46-package dependency and vulnerability policy; exact Web/SDK runtimes, locks, audits and build budgets.
Repository/architecture/generation/source gates, real PostgreSQL 12-to-13 upgrade/ACL/index/rollback evidence, deterministic scan/Web negative regressions and M0 native provenance.
Expected fail-closed release decisions remain unchanged; final diff and task-result schema/file-list checks are recorded in tests.md.
technical_debt: Compose existing authentication/bootstrap/recovery components with real rotatable authorization, TLS/persistent keys and controlled read-only Host before adding more disconnected components.
Provide handle/no-follow namespace evidence, supervised filesystem isolation and real NAS/scale tests before enabling corresponding production capabilities.
Retain separate SCM/systemd/Docker, Provider and Explorer release evidence; standalone Windows client precedes deep Explorer integration.
Preserve historical handoffs/branches and the explicitly documented approval-blocked empty sandbox directories.
